Uday Gill | uday.gill363@example.com | +91 9264409407
Driven talent acquisition professional focused on building technical and high-volume hiring pipelines. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Ola — Jun 2019 - Present
Led technical and campus hiring initiatives across multiple product and operations teams. Designed targeted sourcing campaigns and improved offer-to-acceptance velocity by implementing structured interview scorecards and focused candidate nurturing. Built and maintained talent pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter and HRIS integrations; partnered with engineering leads to define role competencies and reduce time-to-offer. Managed high-volume drives, coordinated campus programs, and introduced Git- and Linux-focused assessment checkpoints for technical hires.

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Pixelwave Studios — Apr 2019 - May 2019
Executed short-term ramp hiring for a product launch, rapidly sourcing and screening candidates for engineering and design roles. Leveraged LinkedIn Recruiter and Workday to track applicants and streamline interview scheduling. Coordinated with hiring managers to close critical roles within tight timelines, and captured hiring metrics in HRIS for post-hire analysis.

HR Executive, Quanta Retail — Apr 2017 - Mar 2019
Administered HRIS for workforce records, maintained compliance, and supported end-to-end recruitment efforts. Used LinkedIn Recruiter to source retail operations and corporate candidates, conducted initial screenings, and facilitated onboarding processes. Improved new-hire documentation turnaround and standardised candidate data in HRIS.

Skills: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter, Workday, HRIS, Linux, Git

Education: M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
